reviews.review: Though old, it's worth every penny to smash Orcs and use the Chainsword. Never has such as game drawn me in with it's brutish combat. A true mans game. One that will live on for eternity.
Wouldn't suck if it wasn't two hours long. Space Marine 2 is better.
RAAAAAAAH FOR THE EMPERORRR! Beat the ♥♥♥♥ out of golems game with a not bad not good story

The game is constantly trying to kill you using bullcrap tactics, the devs mix in insta kill exploding dogs into the orks so you cannot effectively mellee them, they give the orks ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ enemies that launch missiles which can kill you easily, the game has a lot of sections where you are tricked into advancing and then killed for not being careful enough. It is a ♥♥♥♥♥♥ way to keep a player engaged and inevitably makes the experience unfun. In addition to that there are long sections where you need to have good ranged weapons to succeed, as an example i will give part 4 there is a section where you battle chaos from distance if you do not have a las cannon or a stalker bolter here you are in for a ♥♥♥♥♥♥ time, to add insult to injury the game gives you a Storm Bolter right before this in a pod which makes you think that there is a Close Quarter Combat section coming up instead of the 2 ranged combat sections. It's like the devs are trying to hinder your experience by pulling cheap tricks. There are moments where this game is really fun, treamendously fun but when there are this many things that ruin it the game starts to feel bad.  Before i forget i should mention chaos, the common enemies aren't bad, the soldiers can kill you surprisingly fast but for their health i wouldn't really complain. The Astartes are tanky though thats how they are supposed to be and it isn't bad when the game doesn't force you to fight them from range without giving you any weapons that are good at range. The floating enemies suck, you get either a beam that melts your health from afar or a drone that shoots you with a huge health pool, both of them equally annoying. Overall this has been a bad experience and i will not be coming back to this game, this was a waste of my 5 dollars.
